access.anon: Can query weather for USTC campus locations.
access.user: Can query weather for USTC campus locations.
access.admin: Can query weather for USTC campus locations.
access.agent: Can read weather snapshots for USTC campus locations.

rules.public-no-signin: Weather is public campus life information; sign-in should not be a prerequisite.
rules.two-locations-only: Only two locations are tracked: ustc-main (本部, Amap adcode 340100) covers the closely clustered east/west/south/north/central campuses, and ustc-gaoxin (高新校区, adcode 340104 Shushan — the Gaoxin campus's district; the economic-zone adcode 340171 has no AMap weather coverage) covers the distant Gaoxin campus.
rules.amap-primary: Amap (高德) is the primary provider; Open-Meteo supplements hourly forecast, precipitation probability, and other fields Amap does not return. The merged snapshot lists which providers contributed.
rules.raw-extensions-preserved: Provider payloads are merged into a canonical snapshot and the raw Amap/Open-Meteo responses stay available under extensions for REST and MCP consumers.
rules.cache-and-history: Snapshots are cached in the WEATHER KV namespace for 15 minutes per location and persisted to WeatherObservation history; a scheduled cron refreshes both locations to stay within the Amap monthly quota.
rules.location-key-boundary: REST, GraphQL, and MCP accept only the canonical locationKey values ustc-main and ustc-gaoxin; unknown keys are rejected as bad input.

routes.returns: { location, fetchedAt, providers, current, hourly, daily, alerts, extensions }
notes: Optional locationKey query parameter: ustc-main (default) or ustc-gaoxin.
Returns 503 when every provider is unavailable.

queries.name: weather
notes: locationKey must be one of the canonical weather location keys.
Returns null when every provider is unavailable.

tools.name: catalog_weather_get
tools.returns: { location, fetchedAt, providers, current, hourly, daily, alerts, extensions }
notes: Accepts locationKey (default ustc-main) and mode inputs.
Default mode returns the merged snapshot without provider extensions; full mode returns the complete payload including raw provider extensions.
